pizzeria.name: Pizzeria owner
pizzeria.voice: warm, impatient, older man, slight Turku accent in English

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Turku, 2027. Last month you were a software developer. Then came the redundancy talks, and thousands of jobs like yours went to AI.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The austerity package abolished unemployment benefits, earnings-related and basic alike. The only work left is the work robots cannot yet do on their own.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A traditional pizzeria on Linnankatu needs a courier, but first you need a courier permit, and the only ones left are rented out on the black market. You have 120 euros.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rent a courier permit at the black market under Auransilta.

lines.speaker: narrator

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Welcome to the black market. Permits, plates, spare organs. Keep your voice down.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Permit ran out already? They always come back.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Ten deliveries. If the platform asks, you've been riding since 2024.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Fresh plates. Now every car on the street is yours, as far as the platform knows.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Four hundred, cash. Take the stairs slowly from now on.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: There. The platform will warn you again. Nobody ever warns me.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Cash first, friend. I don't do credit.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: So you're the new courier? Good. Hot pizza, fast legs, no excuses.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: No permit, no deliveries. The platform checks everything now.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Back already? Good, the next one is coming out of the oven.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Cancelled? The robots never get cancelled. Take the next one.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Hungry, or here to work? Either way, make it quick.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Why are you still here? That pizza is getting cold!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Here, eat it on the way. The next order won't wait.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Beat the par time and they tip up to 8 euros. Take twice as long and they cancel.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Four euros. This is a pizzeria, not a charity.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Linnankatu 13a, just up the street. Go, before the cheese sets!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Aurakatu 1, by the bridge. Don't stop to look at the river.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Läntinen Rantakatu 3, all the way down the river. Move it!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Kaskenkatu 4a, across the river and up the hill. That's a long one.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Next one's out of the oven. Go, before the cheese sets!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Here, hot box, cold street. The address is on the slip. Move it!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Another one. The robots want this job, so do it fast.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Take it and run. The customer already tracks you on the app.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Fresh one. Don't eat it on the way, I count the slices.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Go, go! Every minute is a euro off your tip.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Wheels! Scooters, cars, everything runs. Mostly.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One scooter, barely ridden. It's waiting for you right by the kerb.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Three hundred and fifty, and she's yours. The keys are in it.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Half price, take it or leave it. Pleasure doing business.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Cash only, friend. Deliver a few more pizzas first.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: No courier permit? Then what do you need wheels for? Come back with one.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Already? It's still steaming. Keep the change!

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks. Right on time, more or less.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Finally. It's barely warm, you know.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That was quick! The app said twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks, just put it on the step.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: The drone next door gets here faster than you.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Wow, a human courier, and a fast one. Here, take something extra.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Good, I was just about to give up on dinner.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Did you walk here from Helsinki?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Up the whole hill already? You deserve a tip.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Long climb, huh? Thanks anyway.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Cold pizza on a cold evening. Lovely.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Already? The delivery robot quoted forty minutes and a software update.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Still hot! Here, a tip. Don't tell the algorithm.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That was fast. Are you sure you're not a drone in a hoodie?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Perfect timing. My standup call just ended, and so did my job.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Wow. Take the tip before the austerity package finds it.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Faster than the tram, and the tram doesn't even run anymore.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Steaming hot. You must really need the money. Here.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: You ran here? Respect. My knees retired before I did.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hot pizza and a human face. That's worth a few euros these days.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Quick! Keep the change. It's going to be worthless soon anyway.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Great, it's still warm. Unlike the job market.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: You beat my fridge's estimate. It's very disappointed in itself.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks. About as warm as the economy, but it'll do.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Right on time, more or less. That's more than the bus manages.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Fine, fine. Leave it by the door, next to my unemployment letter.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Okay. The app gave you three stars. I gave you four.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks. I'd tip more, but the benefits office closed.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Not bad. My old company's chatbot would have taken longer.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: It's pizza and it's here. Low bar in 2027, but you cleared it.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thank you. Mind the stairs, the landlord sold the handrail.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Good enough. Everyone's a courier now, you know. Even my dentist.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks. Lukewarm, like the river in February.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Here you go. Don't spend it all on courier permits.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Acceptable. I'll leave a review the robots can read.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Finally. I almost asked the delivery drone to adopt me.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Cold. Just like the river in January.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Did you stop for a swim in the river on the way?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: My cat starved twice while I waited. No tip.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: The cheese has set. So has my opinion of you.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I could have walked to Helsinki and back. No tip.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: The robots are slower than you, but at least they apologise.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Is this pizza or archaeology? Lovely.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Cold pizza on a cold evening. Very Turku of you.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I aged a year in that time. My pension didn't.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: You're lucky the robots are on strike today.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Ah, the courier. I'd given up on you and on humanity.
